verdict.line: You lose if you stand still for Urgot's Disdain-into-Purge combo before level 3; you win every extended duel after that because your Q outranges his only engage tool.

brief.thesis: Kled wins this matchup (53.8% over 65 games, lane and solo-kill edge) because his Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) hooks from 800 range while Urgot's only gap-closer, E (Disdain), only reaches 475 — Kled dictates when the fight starts. The one window Urgot controls is early: if he lands Disdain and immediately follows with W (Purge), he stacks Echoing Flames procs on a stationary target, exactly the OP.GG warning.

theirWindow.when: His E (Disdain) is off cooldown, levels 3-5
theirWindow.what: Don't walk into his 475-range Disdain. If he lands it and flips you, he'll chain W (Purge) for repeated Echoing Flames blasts — back off with E (Jousting) recast instead of trading through it.

yourWindow.when: Right after he uses E (16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cd)
yourWindow.what: Dash in with E (Jousting), land Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) to yank him, and pop W (Violent Tendencies) for the empowered 4th hit — he has no answer to the engage until Disdain resets.

start.why: 69.6% pick rate at 47.3% WR — sustain and AD for the extended early trades this lane rewards.

boots.why: 81.4% pick rate (57.9% WR) — Urgot's damage is almost entirely basic attacks and Echoing Flames procs, so flat physical reduction cuts both.

core.why: Builds into the highest-sample core path (24.5% pick) and scales Kled's auto-reliant W (Violent Tendencies) damage.
Shred stacks from E (Jousting) re-dashes and W autos let you out-trade Urgot's tankier itemization.
Survivability against his Q (Corrosive Charge) poke and R (Fear Beyond Death) execute threshold.

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained healing on a stacking adaptive buff matches Kled's repeated E dash-and-return trade pattern against a lane where you're favoured to win extended fights.

summoners.why: 73.8% pick rate — matches your measured solo-kill advantage; Ignite closes out all-ins before Urgot can kite with Q (Corrosive Charge) slow.

playing.title: Hook from outside Disdain range
playing.detail: Your Q is 800 range, his E (Disdain) is only 475. Initiate from max Q range so he can never flip you before you've already committed the yank.

playing.title: Never stand still after he lands Disdain
playing.detail: If he catches you with E, immediately E (Jousting) away or recast to dash back through him — standing still lets his W (Purge) chain Echoing Flames procs for free.

playing.title: Watch Skaarl's courage bar mid-fight
playing.detail: Getting dismounted during his all-in strips your Q entirely (it becomes Pocket Pistol) and cuts your damage to champions — don't start fights already low on Skaarl's health.

playing.title: Pop W before you commit the engage
playing.detail: Activate Violent Tendencies before E-dashing in so the empowered 4th attack lands inside the trade, not after he's already disengaged.

playing.title: All-in the moment his E goes down
playing.detail: His Disdain cooldown (16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) is the only window where he has zero engage or escape — that's when your E-Q-W chain is safest.

playing.title: Save R for a real punish, not a poke
playing.detail: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is a 140-110s cooldown; use it to close a level 6+ all-in or answer a gank, not to chip him down.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, pick rates, build paths, runes, and summoner choices above are measured from live games on the current patch; the trade timing, cooldown comparisons, and matchup reasoning are my own read of the kit interactions.
